name: org-create-reminder-arms-a-durable-recurring-reminder-for-yourself
description: The happy path: one `POST /v1/reminders/arm` carrying the exact prompt and intervalMs. `personId` defaults to the caller and `recurring` defaults server-side, so neither is forced into the payload, and `createdByPersonId` is absent from the body because chiefd credits the reminder to the person whose enrolled key authenticated the pane (DECISIONS.md 2026-08-10) — it is on the ANSWER, not the request. chiefd allocates the id and nextDueAt, and its response body is the tool's `details` unchanged. Replayed against the real route by apps/chiefd/crates/chiefd-api/tests/conformance_reminders.rs.

ok.message: Scheduled reminder reminder:chief:1 — every 1 hour, first due 2026-07-15T13:00:00.000Z.
